description: A printing company sells math workbooks and English workbooks. To meet demand, they must make at least 40 math workbooks and at least 60 English workbooks. However, they can make at most 140 math workbooks and at most 170 English workbooks. The company has a contract with a school to send at least 200 workbooks of either type. If the profit per math workbook is $15 and the profit per English workbook is $17, how many of each should the company make to maximize profit?

MinMathWorkbooks.definition: Minimum number of math workbooks to produce

MinEnglishWorkbooks.definition: Minimum number of English workbooks to produce

MaxMathWorkbooks.definition: Maximum number of math workbooks to produce

MaxEnglishWorkbooks.definition: Maximum number of English workbooks to produce

MinTotalWorkbooks.definition: Minimum total number of workbooks to produce

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing math and English workbooks"

constraints.description: MinMathWorkbooks <= The number of math workbooks produced <= MaxMathWorkbooks
MinEnglishWorkbooks <= The number of English workbooks produced <= MaxEnglishWorkbooks
The total number of math and English workbooks produced must be at least MinTotalWorkbooks

MathWorkbooks.definition: The number of math workbooks produced

EnglishWorkbooks.definition: The number of English workbooks produced
